series.title: Her Wolf, Her Wrath
series.description: In her previous life, Verity was deceived by a villainous family and brutally murdered by them. Only in her final moments did she finally realize that Kyle—the so-called savage wolf king she had believed to be her cruel, monstrous captor—was in fact the one who truly loved and protected her. After being reborn, Verity resolutely chose Kyle and used his sharp claws to exact revenge for herself and her deceased parents. In the end, the two found their happily ever after.

series.title: My Student Knows My Sin
series.description: Clara, a 28-year-old math teacher, is trapped in a seven-year sham marriage to a hypocritical politician who represses her desires through coldness and abuse. When she accidentally swaps bags with Damian, a ruthless heir to a school conglomerate, he discovers her hidden toy and blackmails her into becoming his private plaything. Desperate, Clara seeks help from her husband, only to be blamed and beaten. In a defiant act, she self-harms to resist Damian, exposing her marital suffering. When leaked photos spark a campus scandal, her husband plots to institutionalize her. But Damian, wielding real power, steps in—igniting a fierce struggle over her fate, caught between repression, desire, and revenge.

series.title: The Dragon Lord's Forbidden Captive Bride
series.description: Sophie, a girl with hidden Phoenix blood, has long been ostracized and exploited by her Avian kin, forced as a sacrifice for tribal peace. Meek in appearance yet tough-willed, she endures family betrayal, her lover’s suspicion and repeated tortures. Trapped in captivity, she never surrenders. Through life-or-death separation and bloodline awakening, she breaks free of dual tribal shackles, seeks justice for her loved ones and herself, and finally achieves mutual affection with the Dragon Lord, gaining redemption for both her family and herself.

series.title: The Next Mate: My Ex's Father-In-Law
series.description: Judy, adopted and loving her fated mate Ethan, is cruelly dumped when he courts Erin, daughter of Alpha Gavin, to secure the pack leadership. Heartbroken, she nearly falls into Gavin's arms, but the aloof Alpha keeps his distance. Her adoptive father is jailed; Ethan demands she become his mistress; she refuses. Gavin reluctantly hires her as his son's tutor, and despite his cold reserve, an undeniable bond forms. Ethan schemes relentlessly, spreading rumors, sabotaging her scholarship, but Gavin dismantles every move. Driven mad with envy, Ethan kidnaps and drugs Judy on the full moon eve. Gavin tears through the pack to save her. That night, barriers shatter and love explodes. At the inauguration, Gavin exposes Ethan's crimes, strips his spirit wolf, and defies centuries of pack law to declare Judy his one and only Luna, chosen, not fated. Together, they stand against prejudice and walk into the future side by side.

series.title: They Called Me the Other Woman
series.description: On her seventh wedding anniversary, heiress Evelyn Carter is ambushed by Sophie, a viral TikTok influencer with millions of followers, who livestreams her way into Evelyn’s estate, humiliating and attacking her on camera while branding her a homewrecker. What no one realizes is Andrew is her lawful husband, and Sophie is the real other woman. As the truth unravels, an even deeper conspiracy surfaces: Evelyn’s most trusted best friend Mia has been secretly working with Andrew to seize control of the Carter Group empire. But Evelyn has known everything from the very first day.

series.title: Trapped in His Grip, She Can Never Escape
series.description: Song Cha fell in love with Wan Ni at first sight after she saved him. He boldly interrupted her wedding to Hu En and married her. Song Cha's protective nature won Wan Ni's heart, but Hu En, consumed by jealousy over Wan Ni's change of heart, killed her father and framed Song Cha. Confronted in an abandoned factory, Hu En tried to kill them both but was overpowered by Song Cha. The police arrived, arresting Hu En, and Song Cha, though achieving his desire to be with Wan Ni, faced punishment for his crimes.
